title: Positioning manuscripts in the scientific landscape with agentic AI
abstract: arXiv:2609.13760v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Publishing a research manuscript is a routine yet demanding part of scientific life: time-consuming, stressful, and often uncertain in outcome. Recent advances in large language model (LLM)-based agentic AI have shown promise across a range of scientific tasks, and here we ask whether agentic AI can help researchers navigate the publication process itself by reliably inferring a manuscript's eventual publication venue from its content and literature context. We introduce PASS (Publication-oriented Agentic Scientific System), an agentic system that understands manuscripts within their domain-specific literature context and predicts top-matched publication venues. PASS positions each manuscript within its surrounding literature landscape by reconstructing its local scientific neighborhood, tracing its topic trajectory, and reasoning over field-specific journal spaces. translated_title: 利用智能体AI在科学版图中定位手稿
translated_abstract: 发表研究手稿是科学生活中常规但要求苛刻的一部分：耗时、充满压力，且结果往往不确定。基于大语言模型的智能体AI的最新进展已在一系列科学任务中展现出前景，我们在此探究智能体AI能否通过从手稿的内容和文献背景中可靠地推断出手稿最终的发表期刊，来帮助研究人员应对发表过程本身。我们提出了PASS（面向发表的智能体科学系统），这是一个能够在特定领域的文献背景中理解手稿并预测最匹配发表期刊的智能体系统。PASS通过重建手稿的局部科学邻域、追踪其主题轨迹，并在特定领域的期刊空间中进行推理，将每篇手稿定位在其周围的文献版图之中。该系统在一个经过泄露审计的、涵盖2000多份预印本的基准上进行了评估。
tldr: 本文提出了PASS智能体系统，通过在领域文献背景中理解手稿、重建其科学邻域并追踪主题轨迹，从而预测手稿最匹配的发表期刊，帮助研究人员应对论文发表过程中的不确定性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces PASS, an agentic AI system that understands manuscripts within their domain-specific literature context, reconstructs their scientific neighborhoods, and traces their topic trajectories to predict best-matched publication venues, helping researchers navigate the uncertain publication process.
